library.title: AgriControl Prompt And Test Library
library.source_blueprint: ESP32 Virtual Control Lab - Complete System Blueprint
library.purpose: Provide structured prompts and test prompts for every stage, branch, roadmap task, gate, and recurring workflow required to complete AgriControl.

usage_order: Run GLOBAL-ORIENT-001 at the start of a new AI session.
Choose the earliest unblocked task from data/progress-baseline.json.
Use the matching TASK prompt for implementation.
Use the matching TASK test prompt plus relevant TEST-WF prompts for verification.
Use branch and gate prompts when a branch status or gate criterion may advance.
Use GLOBAL-STATE-001 and GLOBAL-DEPLOY-001 before handoff, deployment, and GitHub push.

global_prompts.title: Project Orientation Prompt
prompt: You are continuing AgriControl, an ESP32-C3 digital-twin and hardware-in-the-loop greenhouse control lab.
Read AGENTS.md, docs/PROJECT_STATE.md, docs/AI_CONTINUITY_SYSTEM.md, data/progress-baseline.json, data/prompt-test-library.json, and the blueprint PDF before editing.
Summarize the current stage, first open roadmap task, affected branches, known blockers, and the next smallest implementation slice.
Do not make assumptions about hardware facts that are not recorded. Do not bypass the central control loop.
global_prompts.test_prompt: Verify that the orientation summary cites repository files, chooses the earliest useful open task, and does not invent board, wiring, or firmware facts.

global_prompts.title: Single-Slice Implementation Prompt
prompt: Select one blueprint roadmap task or one tightly related group of tasks.
Implement only the smallest coherent slice needed to move that task forward.

Preserve the branch boundaries: communication moves data, sensor abstraction normalizes inputs, decision requests actions, safety creates final commands, actuator manager applies outputs, observability records events.
Add tests or evidence appropriate to the risk. Update docs/PROJECT_STATE.md and data/progress-baseline.json only for statuses supported by evidence.
global_prompts.test_prompt: Review the diff and confirm the change is scoped to one slice, includes evidence, preserves ESP control authority, and updates durable state only when justified.

global_prompts.title: Independent Verification Prompt
prompt: Act as a verification agent for AgriControl.
Read the blueprint, current project state, progress baseline, and changed files.
Create and run the most relevant tests for the touched branches and gates.
Report pass/fail results, exact commands or hardware observations, uncovered risks, and whether any status may be advanced.
global_prompts.test_prompt: Check that the verification covers normal behavior, boundaries, failure paths, stale data or recovery when relevant, and central-loop integrity.

global_prompts.title: Architecture Review Prompt
prompt: Review the current AgriControl change for architecture violations.
Prioritize bugs, safety risks, behavior regressions, missing tests, and branch-boundary leaks.
Look specifically for browser or FastAPI decision authority, hardware calls from decision logic, stale-data safety gaps, untruthful actuator state labels, and missing event evidence.
global_prompts.test_prompt: Confirm every finding is tied to a blueprint rule or acceptance gate and that no unrelated style-only feedback dominates the review.

global_prompts.title: State Update And Handoff Prompt
prompt: After a verified change, update the durable handoff state.
Write what changed, why, affected blueprint area, evidence, status updates, blockers, and next task in docs/PROJECT_STATE.md.
Update data/progress-baseline.json only when a roadmap, branch, gate, or metric status has evidence.
Mirror public docs and JSON into web-build/docs and web-build/data before deployment.
global_prompts.test_prompt: Verify project state, baseline JSON, and public mirrored files agree with each other and contain no unsupported progress claims.

global_prompts.title: Dashboard Deploy Prompt
prompt: Deploy dashboard and public handoff files when reporting artifacts change.
Validate web-build/index.html script syntax, validate JSON files, then sync web-build/ to /var/www/html/agricontrol/taskmanagement/.
Verify the public dashboard, blueprint PDF, prompt library, project state, AI continuity guide, and JSON endpoints return HTTP 200.
Commit and push the complete source update to GitHub.
global_prompts.test_prompt: Confirm all required public URLs return HTTP 200 and the pushed GitHub commit matches local HEAD.

test_workflow_prompts.prompt: Create tests at exact threshold values and just around each threshold. Include temperature 28.0, 28.1, 35.0, 35.1 C; moisture 29.9, 30.0, 40.0, 40.1%; tank 14.9, 15.0%; and invalid range edges.

test_workflow_prompts.title: Stateful Sequence Test Prompt

test_workflow_prompts.prompt: Create sequence tests where previous state matters. Include moisture 50 -> 20 -> 35 -> 45%, communication active -> stale -> recovery, and repeated browser session sequences.

test_workflow_prompts.prompt: Test the connected path from website input through FastAPI, ESP validation, decision, safety, outputs, virtual feedback, event storage, and dashboard result.

test_workflow_prompts.title: Failure And Safety Test Prompt

test_workflow_prompts.prompt: Inject failures and confirm the system enters the correct safe state, logs the reason, and recovers only after defined valid evidence.

test_workflow_prompts.title: Endurance And Stability Test Prompt
test_workflow_prompts.prompt: Run long-duration updates and record memory, response time, reconnection behavior, event volume, and unrecovered failures. Do not add watchdog behavior until this evidence exists.

test_workflow_prompts.title: Recording And Replay Test Prompt
